title: Carried menu links and form controls retain exact native parent outcomes
steps: Hide a header link naming an already scheduled menu-item hide, including kept-page and native refusal cases.
Close a contact form through the full write step and inspect the hidden submit button and its label.
Reopen the menu item or form setting and run read-back; include shared controls and coincidental fixed-text labels.
expect: Only the exact existing menu operation can carry a header link; its refusal and kept-page guard propagate.
Only a successful matching form closure carries its submit button, using the same ordered setting and read-back receipt.
Reopened native settings fail read-back. Unmatched parents, shared live controls and fixed-word substring matches stay blocked.
fence: existing exact native menu/form receipts; no extra writes or inferred fixed-text removal
